line: Got a shoestring ’round the thing thing, they don’t build like this Okay, I’m floating, ayy
vault_lines: Got a shoestring 'round the thing thing, they don't build like this
meaning:
“Thing-thing” could refer to a firearm. Semi-automatic rifles can be modified to become a automatic rifle by wrapping a shoestring around the weapon.

In 2004 The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) ruled that a semi-automatic weapon with a shoestring attached to it is considered a machine gun, as the cycling rate is increased drastically.

21 Savage, the featured artist on this track, also rapped about using this method on “Pull Up N Wreck.”

Got a shoestring ‘round my TEC, lil’ nigga (facts)

line: Floating, I’m floating, floating, floating, floating, floating Floating, I’m floating, floating, floating, floating, floating Swag on max, got no legs, bitch, I’m floating Might turn into a ghost, punk bitch, yes, I’m floating Floating, I’m floating, floating, floating, floating, floating, floating Floating, I’m floating, floating, floating, floating, floating, floating Swag on max, got no legs, bitch, I’m floating Might turn into a ghost, punk bitch, yes, I’m floating (Woo)
vault_lines: Floating, I'm floating, floating, floating, floating, floating
meaning:
“Floating” refers to the high ScHoolboy Q and 21 Savage get from taking drugs, likely psychedelics. When high, one reaches a state of euphoria that could make you feel like you’re flying high through the air – floating, in a way. Of course, taking too many drugs could result in an lethal overdose, which in turn would make Q a ghost.

It could also refer to the two rappers having so much “ice” – jewelry – that when it starts to figuratively melt, they’re floating in the water.

meaning: KIDZ BOP bills itself as “the #1 music brand for kids”. KIDZ BOP features children performing the lyrics to popular songs- primarily those featured on the Billboard Top 100. Q’s face tattoos can be viewed here.

line: Sauce everywhere and got broccoli in my Ziploc
vault_lines: Sauce everywhere and got broccoli in my Ziploc
meaning:
Broccoli is often accompanied by a sauce such as creamy mushroom or cheese due to it’s bland taste.



Broccoli is also slang for marijuana which probably explains why ScHoolboy Q would be carrying it around.

Ziploc is an international company that produces plastic storage packets and are known for their quality material and zipping system hence their name being a combination of zip and lock.

ScHoolboy Q  says that he has so much sauce that if he ever wants to eat broccoli he can add his own sauce to it.

line: I’m Slaughter Gang Savage Freak hoes get punched just for trying to kiss me (21, 21)
meaning:
Slaughter Gang is 21 Savage’s gang, which he often raps about. For example, in “Red Opps”:

I’m on that Slaughter Gang shit, Murder Gang shit

On Metro Boomin’s November 2018 track “Don’t Come Out the House,” he raps:

Slaughter Gang so I keep a knife, nigga

He also has a mixtape titled The Slaughter Tape and one titled Slaughter King.
